translations.en: I’m going to bed early because I have to get up early tomorrow.

translations.it: Vado a dormire presto perché domani devo alzarmi presto.

translations.yue: 我會早啲瞓，因為聽日我要早起。

translations.en: I’m not going out now because my shoes are wet.
